baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Empire army book; WH: The Old World (2023+) Empire background (Emperor elected by the Electors; Sigmar the state cult; Imperial State Troops)
baseline.why: An electoral aristocracy (landed voting) under a hereditary Elector Count, Sigmarite state cult, provincial militias (state troops), Shallyan hospices, and gunpowder-plus-guild tech at tier 3

chaos_warband.source: canon: WFB 8e Warriors of Chaos; WH: The Old World (Brass Keep held by Nurgle warbands since 2302 IC)
chaos_warband.why: A fortress held by a Chaos warband is a tribal raiding host, not an Imperial province

skaven_placeholder.source: canon: WFB 8e Skaven army book (clans under Warlords, Grey Seers of the Horned Rat, slave-taking); placeholder clans, no named canon clan
skaven_placeholder.why: An unnamed Skaven clan is a warlord-ruled swarm with no schooling, tribute-taxed and slave-raiding; held at tier 6 for lack of a clan-specific source

wood_elf_realm.source: canon: WFB 8e Wood Elves army book (Athel Loren and the Asrai enclaves ruled by Glade Lords and Spellweavers, closed to outsiders); TW:WH2 Wood Elves
wood_elf_realm.why: Secretive forest realms: warrior-caste Glade Guard, no trade or migration, little taxation, no slavery, no schooling beyond the Spellsingers' lore; held at tier 6 as the mod's lowest elven rung (no industry)

laws.lawgroup_governance_principles.source: canon: WFRP Marienburg (the seceded Wasteland is run by merchant councils, no hereditary monarch)
laws.lawgroup_governance_principles.why: A council republic of merchant houses.

laws.lawgroup_distribution_of_power.source: canon: WFRP Marienburg (rule by the wealthy merchant houses and guilds)
laws.lawgroup_distribution_of_power.why: Wealth voting is the closest to merchant oligarchy.

laws.lawgroup_church_and_state.source: canon: WFRP Marienburg (cosmopolitan port tolerating many cults: Manann, Sigmar, Ranald, Shallya)

laws.lawgroup_army_model.source: canon: WFRP Marienburg (Marienburg pays professional mercenary and guard regiments)

laws.lawgroup_bureaucracy.source: canon: WFRP Marienburg (offices elected by the merchant councils)

laws.lawgroup_navy_model.source: canon: WFRP Marienburg (Marienburg is the Empire's greatest naval and merchant port)
laws.lawgroup_navy_model.why: A standing war fleet as well as merchantmen.

laws.lawgroup_economic_system.why: Laissez-faire in a city of merchants.

laws.lawgroup_taxation.why: Per-capita tax on a monetised city economy.

laws.lawgroup_migration.source: canon: WFRP Marienburg (cosmopolitan; Halflings, Elves, Dwarfs and all races present)

laws.lawgroup_colonization.source: canon: WFRP Marienburg (trading posts and overseas ventures)

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFRP Marienburg (merchant houses and shipping magnates)

institutions.why: Marienburg invests in colonial affairs beside schools and health.

tech_tier.why: A pastoral realm with Imperial trade goods but no industry of its own.

laws.lawgroup_governance_principles.why: An elected Elder rather than a hereditary monarch.

laws.lawgroup_church_and_state.source: canon: WFB Empire (Halflings honour Rhya and Esmeralda, ancestors, no dominant cult)

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB Empire (halfling yeomen, cooks and innkeepers)

laws.lawgroup_church_and_state.why: Sea-god Manann and Ulric sit beside Sigmar in the province, so no single state cult.

TAL.note: Talabheim, the Eye of the Empire, fortified city in a crater.

tech_tier.source: canon: WFB 8e Vampire Counts (undead armies of ancient arms; Sylvania is agrarian, mist-bound)
tech_tier.why: Wight and zombie levies use old arms; Sylvania has none of Nuln's industry.

laws.lawgroup_distribution_of_power.source: canon: WFB 8e Vampire Counts (the Count of Sylvania rules absolutely)
laws.lawgroup_distribution_of_power.why: A vampire lord answers to no assembly.

laws.lawgroup_army_model.source: canon: WFB 8e Vampire Counts (raised dead and press-ganged levies)

laws.lawgroup_citizenship.why: The living are subjects of the blood-line.

laws.lawgroup_land_reform.source: canon: WFB 8e Vampire Counts (peasants are cattle bound to the land)

laws.lawgroup_slavery.source: canon: WFB 8e Vampire Counts (the living serve as blood-stock)
laws.lawgroup_slavery.why: Debt slavery is the closest law to bondage of the living.

laws.lawgroup_migration.source: canon: WFB Vampire Counts (Sylvania is closed off by cursed borders)

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB 8e Vampire Counts (vampire lords and their necromantic cult)
ruling_igs.why: Undead soldiery and the cult are the ruling blocs.

tech_tier.source: canon: WFB 8e Empire (Imperial Gunnery School and steam-tank works at Nuln)

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB 8e Empire (Nuln gunnery school, Imperial cannon foundries)
ruling_igs.why: Gunnery officers and foundry masters share the ruling bloc.
